ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Script Run in AppData
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious command line execution that invokes PowerShell with reference to an AppData folder

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\pwsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pwsh\\\.exe.*")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/c\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Local\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Roaming\\\\.*"))))
